notes:
Sigil 1.13.0-beta.2 (Experimental)

Adds confirmed Experimental opt-in, a separate signed update feed and the Relic character-sheet theme. Experimental uses a one-time copy of your Stable data in a separate local profile; subsequent edits do not synchronize. Turning Experimental off selects Stable updates and preserves this profile, while the installed binary remains Experimental until a newer compatible Stable build replaces it. Never automatically downgrades. Export/import requires compatible Character formats.

Windows x64 installer includes WebView2. In-app updates use the existing trusted updater signing key; this installer is not Authenticode-signed.

Also prevents snapshot filename collisions when Windows returns identical timestamps to concurrent launches. The beta.1 publication was stopped by CI before any public release.
